verdict: Spend produced 2 leads and 9 purchases this period — volume is critically thin against a $4,517 investment.
diagnosis: Cost per lead sits near $2,258 this period versus a healthcare norm around $57, driven by weak lead capture despite 2,066 clicks.

signals.headline: Only 2 leads from $4,517 spend
signals.detail: Lead volume is nearly nonexistent this period. The funnel is converting clicks to purchases, not to captured leads.

signals.headline: 9 purchases returned $5,897 revenue
signals.detail: Purchases outpaced leads 4-to-1 this period. Buyers are skipping the lead form and going straight to checkout.

signals.headline: 138 landing page views from 2,066 clicks
signals.detail: Only 7% of clicks reach the landing page. Tracking gaps or slow load times are likely leaking traffic.

signals.headline: 1 call click, 136 direction requests
signals.detail: Google Business Profile drove almost no phone contact this period. Direction requests suggest local intent going unanswered.

signals.headline: Cost per click averaged $2.61
signals.detail: Click cost sits above the healthcare search average near $1.63. Keyword targeting on 'life alert' faces heavy competition.

recommendations.title: Fix lead tracking before scaling spend
recommendations.detail: Only 2 leads registered this period despite 9 purchases. Consider auditing the pixel and form events to confirm leads are actually being captured.

recommendations.title: Test broader keywords beyond 'life alert'
recommendations.detail: The single keyword is pushing click cost to $2.61. Worth exploring 'medical alert watch' and 'senior fall detection' to widen cheaper inventory.

recommendations.title: Activate the Google Business Profile for calls
recommendations.detail: 136 direction requests produced just 1 call click. Consider adding a call button, offer post, and reviews to convert local intent into phone leads.
